name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
on: push: branches: [ main ]
permissions: contents: read pages: write id-token: write
concurrency: group: "pages" cancel-in-progress: false
jobs: deploy: runs-on: ubuntu-latest environment: name: github-pages url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }} steps: - name: Checkout uses: actions/checkout@v4
- name: Setup Pages uses: actions/configure-pages@v4
- name: Upload artifact uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3 with: path: './navix-app'
- name: Deploy to GitHub Pages id: deployment uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
